---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or a fidelity improvement
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What do you want to do?**

Describe the use case, not only the API you have in mind.

**Current behaviour**

What happens today? If this is about Lua compatibility, mention the PUC
version and a minimal chunk.

**Proposed behaviour**

What should Fengari do? Include a sketch of the Lua/JS API if relevant.

**Alternatives and context**

Existing workarounds, related issues, or links to the Lua manual/source.

**Scope check**

- [ ] This is Lua 5.3 semantics (the default profile)
- [ ] This is about the 5.1/5.2 library profiles
- [ ] This is Lua 5.4 or an extension
- [ ] This affects the browser bundle, the VFS or async modules
